about: Composite progress for `score:<n>` goals: the game's own rewards. Sum of weight x (signal now - signal when the judge started): XP earned (1 per XP) and gear (800 per +1 average item level over the 17 slots). Money and the value of what you own are reported (wealth_copper, money_copper) but not scored: spend them on whatever helps. The run's score is (overall rate + best 15-minute window rate) / 2 in progress points per hour.
